mentions.name: BMI Calculator for Android
mentions.description: This app is a simple, free BMI calculator for Android, built with Expo/React as a first mobile project for learning the entire development process.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on a mobile app, a simple free BMI calculator for Android. Nothing new, fancy, or groundbreaking. It's just that I wanted to start from somewhere. Vibe coding it in Expo/React and figuring out the entire process
